text:
kevin (infra): heads-up — i'm planning a batched tf apply for network+iam across us-west/us-east at 2024-12-05T02:00Z (change window). will do provider pin and small canary in us-west-2 first. deploybot schedule set. need rollback criteria and who owns escape hatch.

maria (platform): +1 on canary. make sure to pin provider versions in root module: `required_providers { aws = { version = \"~> 4.50\" } }` and pin kube provider too. add `provider_pin = true` in deploy config.

olivia (sre): please include deploybot circuit-breaker: fail if >10% routes fail or API error rate spike >5% for 2m. also add `--dry-run` to first batch.

sam (release): tagging release notes: release/2024.12.05-infra. callout for IAM role changes — docs updated: https://confluence.example.com/display/infra/IAM+2024-12-05

kevin (infra): agree. rollback criteria: any 500s on control plane OR new IAM policy denies external services -> immediate rollback. rollback steps in this thread.

devops-bot: [scheduled] deploybot: start batched apply at 3300001234 (canary us-west-2). owner: kevin. notify: #eng-oncall, #security

maria (platform): plan snippet for canary:
```
terraform plan -target=module.network -var='region=us-west-2' -out=canary.plan
terraform apply canary.plan
```
also enabling `-parallelism=10` for speed.

olivia (sre): kevin — if canary passes, what's the pause between waves? recommend 15m and manual checklist: smoke test, e2e, traffic shaping.

kevin (infra): pause 15m. checklist: 1) deploybot reports success, 2) `curl` health check OK, 3) no new 5xx spikes, 4) IAM access tests ok. I will own wave1->wave2 decision. if anything fishy, run `deploybot cancel --id $JOB` and revert with pinned previous state: `terraform state rollback -from=tag/2024-11-30` (ops runbook).

sam (release): noted. I'll update release notes with rollback instructions and who to page. add `#oncall` alias for paging.

maria (platform): one more: rotate the temp deploy SA creds after apply. command: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create --iam-account=deploy-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then store in vault. keep TTL 1h.

kevin (infra): thanks. @olivia @sam i'll ping infra-oncall at T-10 and post final `deploybot start` message. :thumbsup: 

olivia (sre): :thumbsup: good luck. i'll standby for smoke tests.

release-bot: Release note draft saved: release/2024.12.05-infra.chan: "networking + IAM batched apply; canary us-west-2; rollback: immediate revert on 500s or policy deny."

kevin (infra): final: escape hatch is manual revert and provider pin to previous commit; if deploybot stuck, escalate to oncall and run `terraform apply -state=previous.tfstate restore.tf` — have runbook link: https://runbook.example.com/runbooks/tf-rollback
